card.name: Inside brand and generic drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through a drug name in label text, on the piece just before the name finishes, such as the I in KRAZATI, ARD in SYNJARDY, ft in tezacaftor, ib in ivosidenib or if in dapagliflozin.

modes.label: Brand names
modes.description: A middle or final piece of a capitalised brand name.

modes.label: Generic names
modes.description: A middle piece of a generic name ending in -tafor, -nib or -gliflozin.
modes.example: Co-administration of TIBSOVO with strong CYP3A4 inducers decreased ivosiden<<ib>> plasma concentrations

card.writes: It suppresses odd non-drug continuations and adds little useful output, so no clear output effect on drug names.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a drug name that the model is still reading, before the name ends.
